fields.subject: Connection Configuration Hierarchy
fields.trigger: a provider's ShardSets collection is constructed from its bound options type, which implements IShardSetsConfigurationOptions
fields.response: take the configured shard sets solely from ShardSetsConfigInternal: when that view (or the options value) is null, log a warning that the shard configuration section may be missing and produce an empty collection; when any entry is null, throw; otherwise build one shard set per entry keyed by its ShardSetName, carrying the global configuration down to the shard set's endpoints
fields.postcondition: every provider presents its shard-set configuration to the provider-neutral core through one read-only interface
